findings.location: docs/plans/2026-11-05-mempalace-per-clone-use.md — Completion criterion 5; Increment D, Step 1 and “The lock”
findings.problem: The preview must “write nothing,” but it must also acquire a lock whose file and parent directory it creates when absent. On a fresh machine, the specified preview therefore changes the filesystem and cannot pass its required verification. This contradiction was introduced by moving the lock beside the palace.
findings.suggestion: Define whether preview may create the lock file and its parent directory. If permitted, explicitly narrow the no-write guarantee and test those exact filesystem effects; otherwise specify how preview acquires the lock without creating either.

summary: The revised lock design conflicts with the preview’s no-write requirement. The earlier applied findings are otherwise not repeated.
